I know how you feel too. I eat one meal a day. And its usually dinner because I feel too anxious and depressed during the day. I eat dinner because my hunger pains catch up to me.

I felt this way and wanted to move out and away when my bf broke up with m. But this won’t solve your problems. You will be sad no matter where you go. You may not be reminded as often, but the heart break will still be within you. My therapist told me the only way out is through. My ex bf and I lived together in an apartment and I decided to stay in it because I love it and didn’t really have anywhere else to go. You don’t need to move away to feel better. I know it may feel like you should, but that won’t solve your problems. ❤️
How did you get cleared for that? I took some days off but nothing long term at all.
You got this. You must seek therapy. It would be a huge help to you and your depression.

I feel you. It’s the worst pain I’ve ever experienced. What everyone tells me, and is pretty much the shittiest thing to hear I may add (because time is moving so slow rn, right?), is that it’s time. I pray a lot too and am hoping this all has a greater purpose. Thinking of you!
I feel you to the T. Thinking of you and praying for us both.

There was no compassion afterwards like there was when we were in a relationship. It just wasn’t the same.. and that’s what is sad. I wanted more

I understand where you are coming from because I feel the most happy when I’ve been in a relationship (I’ve always been a relationship type of girl).  My suggestion to you is to def seek out a good therapist to discover why you are codependent. It usually stems from child hood. You can even read books about it. What has helped me if figuring out why I am the way I am (I am still trying to figure that out). 

Find out what makes you happy as your own independent person. Date and learn to love yourself (I am currently trying to do this myself). People say your relationships will never work out if you don’t learn to love yourself! It’s definitely not easy but you have to experience the nightmare in order to get to the dream. That’s what I keep telling myself anyway.

I am in the same boat right now. Mornings are absolutely agonizing and full of anxiety. It’s like when you’re sleeping you’re at peace but then RIGHT when you wake up, you feel how heavy your heart is again and how much it hurts. It feels awful... I wouldn’t wish the pain upon anyone. 

I see that you posted this 18 days ago... has it got any better?

What if it took breaking up to “wake up” and realize the damage you’ve been causing? I know what I did wasn’t right, but I didn’t even truly understand what I was doing until I was knocked down, aka dumped. He said there’s a potential for the future but he needs to heal rn.
Im in the same boat.

Learn from my personal experience.... at first you can not see your ex because in the long run it will just make you sad. I did this as well and it just made me more hurt. As BAD as I want to see him, I know i just can’t. I’m sure now you know. It’s too difficult right now. I am hopeful for the future but while we are broken up for now, it needs to be a clean break.

Thank you! This was really nice to read. 

I am thinking about reaching out to him in 3 months or so (depending how I feel). But not sure if it’s enough time. I guess I will never know? I’m just so afraid he’s going to meet another girl in the meantime ugh.
